title: Sprinter Kinetic Energy Lab
introduction: Explore how a sprinter's mass and running speed change the kinetic energy they carry down the track.

guided_steps.instruction: Change the sprinter's mass and watch how the kinetic energy responds.
Increase the running speed and notice how sharply the energy climbs.
Explain why speed matters more than mass for kinetic energy.

reflection_questions.question: What happens to kinetic energy when the running speed increases while mass stays constant?
